entry_context.value: This will apply to the following menus:
1. Attraction Gem Node 3 retention bonus will now cap it's bonus at 1e333 for starters - this will be upgradable to 1e666 and later 1e999 with future gem nodes.
2. Trait Sphere 7 now properly gives x2 to all farm fragments gained (didn't apply the base fragments but only the fragments gained from R6)
3. Relic 13 Bonus from +458 (+0.1 Bank Fill Rate) -> +468 (+0.2 Fill Bank Rate)

byte_context.value: - Gaining LP through achievements or level ups,
- Gaining Diamonds or Tokens through achievements, Chests & Daily Rewards,
- Gaining Tokens from the Token Bank & Chads Tokenium Exchange,
- Gaining Emblems or Hunter Respecs through Achievements & when gaining emblems through the Headquarter,
- Borge or Ozzy Starts a Boss Encounter,
- Borge or Ozzy Wins a Boss Encounter,
These will animate in and stay around for 4 ish seconds when one of the above triggers are met.
We expect to expand this system greatly in the future.
We'd love to do more number formatting options (like full scientific & engineering).
However, this is a massive overhaul and will not happen anytime soon, but we are doing a little portion of that leg-work now.
Besides that, we're going to change how smaller numbers are handled and this will have positive balance implications and speed up some areas of the game (primarily early game)
This is what we're aiming to do with the next patch:
1. No more hidden decimals on MOST upgrades
-> Issue: You have 17 cells but you can't buy an upgrade that costs 17 cells due to the fact that the true cost of the upgrade is 17.0000004 cells.
-> Solution: Most costs around the game now FLOOR or CEILING themselves. This removes all decimals.

-> Elaboration / Example: Early Loop Mods will no longer cost 1, then 1.13, then 1.26, etc. They will keep costing 1 until the cost reaches 2. This speeds up early game as you will be saving mod points by not having to worry about early decimals. The same goes for generators, tech ups, shard upgrades, academy points, etc etc etc. This generally will speed up the game when numbers on a resource are relatively low.
This will apply to the following menus:
1. Attraction Gem Node 3 retention bonus will now cap it's bonus at 1e333 for starters - this will be upgradable to 1e666 and later 1e999 with future gem nodes.
2. Trait Sphere 7 now properly gives x2 to all farm fragments gained (didn't apply the base fragments but only the fragments gained from R6)
3. Relic 13 Bonus from +458 (+0.1 Bank Fill Rate) -> +468 (+0.2 Fill Bank Rate)
4. Relic 18 Bonus from +135 -> +165 & Cost Scaling very slightly decreased
1. Timers (including ozzy boss harden / attack timers) are now way more precise
2. Timmeh, The Time Fill Assistant will now work correctly pre-ouro
3. Inscryption 77 fixed (now applies correctly to all venture modules and not just the first 3)
4. Player Level Bar (circular one up top) should now always be correct
5. Getting 10 levels in a Construction Project will now properly show the automation box, which is OFF by default when unlocking it.
6. x10 LP for ModPoints and Shard bonuses will now correctly show once the ships have been unlocked.
7. Ozzy's "Battle Progress" Text in the battle screen loot area should now be correct
8. Fixed a rare bug that could cause you to get stuck in the Academy Tutorial if you really went out of your way to not follow said tutorial

entry_context.value: Getting yourself "LR Locked" can be fixed by upgrading Borge to get a higher max stage and saving up some Hellish Bio-Matter (HBM).
Due to having the Spoils of War Loop Mods, this will award you more Cells, which in turn fills more Cell Loops in your Zagreus Loop Engine.
You can also save up some HBM for the Loop Requirement Reduction & Tick Loop Req Reduction Inscryptions and purchase those. There is also other Inscryptions that can help, though.

The first few Traversals, loop resets need to be planned a little, rather than just spammed. Buying zag last and waiting for all other ships to finish their installs is a preferable tactic to make sure you don't miss out on any potential extra small MP gains.
Nearing the End of a Traversal:
Perform a few Loop Resets for some extra mods before Traversal. This will net you more Orbs on Traversal (TR):
- Orb gains are affected by how many total Loop Mods you've acquired.
- Orb gains are also affected by how much time you've been in your current TR as well as number of TRs done.
You'll need to Reach Demeter and get your M0 Milestone to 10 before it's recommended to do your first Traversal.

entry_context.value: Congratulations on doing your very first Traversal!
You've got some new content to utilize now, and the primary route to progression for you is to focus on your new Multiversal Hunter, Borge!
As Borge obliterates his enemies, you'll gain various new "Loot" resources - Obsidian, Behlium and Hellish Bio-Matter (HBM).
Focus all your Loot Resources on boosting up Borge's statistics in his Upgrade Menu for at least the first 3-5 hours.

Inside the Multiverse Market you'll find various new upgrades. Focus primarily on Inscryptions (Chrysto's Emporium) that make Borge stronger. The reasoning behind this is, that the stronger borge gets, the more resources you'll be able to acquire, which means you'll be able to acquire other inscryptions later at a faster rate.
For Borge's Skills & Path of Mephisto Node upgrades, pick things that help him survive for longer, such as Lifedrain Inhalers and extra Revives.
Pushing max hunt stage is the biggest path to progress, not only does it give you more Loot Rewards, it also increases the bonuses from the new "Spoils of War" loop mods.
Any long time gains such as offline and overnight gains should be spent mostly back into Borge to increase your Loot Gains further.
For LP, ignoring Cells after 10 LP is prefered. You can return to a 1:2:2 LP spending Ratio in later Traversals (TRs).

This upgrade grants access to a new planet, Karson Krax, which houses 3 new farm missions, and 8 new campaigns to complete in the Academy Menu.
It also increases mission materials gained by x250.
For every level in this loop mod, you get the following bonuses:
This upgrade provides a 1% Mission Retention (additive) per level.
It also provides an 100% increase to Experience Gained from missions, as well as an x100 increase to all Mastery Bonuses.
